arxiv-2106-06729.title: Non-equilibrium dynamics of bacterial colonies — growth, active fluctuations, segregation, adhesion, and invasion
arxiv-2106-06729.creator: Kai Zhou, Marc Hennes, Berenike Maier, Gerhard Gompper, Benedikt Sabass
arxiv-2106-06729.description: Abstract Colonies of bacteria endowed with a pili-based self-propulsion machinery are ideal models for investigating the structure and dynamics of active many-particle systems. We study Neisseria gonorrhoeae colonies with a molecular-dynamics-based approach. A generic, adaptable simulation method for particle systems with fluctuating bond-like interactions is devised.

arxiv-2108-06279.title: (Full original paper)
arxiv-2108-06279.creator: Craig Macdonald, Nicola Tonellotto, Iadh Ounis
arxiv-2108-06279.description: Abstract The advent of contextualised language models has brought gains in search effectiveness, not just when applied for re-ranking the output of classical weighting models such as BM25, but also when used directly for passage indexing and retrieval, a technique which is called dense retrieval.

arxiv-2109-01796.title: Isoperiodic meromorphic forms: two simple poles
arxiv-2109-01796.creator: Gabriel Calsamiglia, Bertrand Deroin
arxiv-2109-01796.description: Abstract . In this paper we prove that isoperiodic moduli spaces of meromorphic differentials with two simple poles on homologically marked smooth curves are non empty and connected, unless they correspond to double covers of ℂ / ℤ \mathbb{C}/\mathbb{Z} on curves of genus at least two. We deduce dynamical consequences for the corresponding isoperiodic foliation.

arxiv-2208-05592.title: Patching open-vocabulary modelsby interpolating weights
arxiv-2208-05592.creator: Gabriel IlharcoUniversity of Washington gamaga@cs.washington.edu, Mitchell WortsmanUniversity of Washington mitchnw@cs.washington.edu, Samir Yitzhak GadreColumbia University sy@cs.columbia.edu Shuran SongColumbia Universiry shurans@cs.columbia.edu Hannaneh HajishirziUniversity of Washington hannaneh
arxiv-2208-05592.description: Abstract Open-vocabulary models like CLIP achieve high accuracy across many image classification tasks. However, there are still settings where their zero-shot performance is far from optimal. We study model patching , where the goal is to improve accuracy on specific tasks without degrading accuracy on tasks where performance is already adequate.

arxiv-2302-06781.title: Proposal of ensemble qubits with two-atom decay
arxiv-2302-06781.creator: Wei Qin, Adam Miranowicz, Franco Nori
arxiv-2302-06781.description: Abstract We propose and analyze a novel approach to implement ensemble qubits. The required anharmonicity is provided by a simultaneous decay of two atoms (i.e., two-atom decay), which is achieved by fully quantum degenerate parametric amplification. For an atomic ensemble, the two-atom decay generates and stabilizes a 2D quantum manifold, which is spanned by the ground and single-excited superradiant states.

arxiv-2307-10798.title: Radio multiwavelength analysis of the compact disk CX Tau: Presence of strong free-free variability or anomalous microwave emission
arxiv-2307-10798.creator: P. Curone, L. Testi, E. Macías, M. Tazzari, S. Facchini, J. P. Williams, C. J. Clarke, A. Natta, G. Rosotti, C. Toci, G. Lodato
arxiv-2307-10798.description: Abstract Protoplanetary disks emit radiation across a broad range of wavelengths, requiring a multiwavelength approach to fully understand their physical mechanisms and how they form planets. Observations at submillimeter to centimeter wavelengths can provide insights into the thermal emission from dust, free-free emission from ionized gas, and possible gyro-synchrotron emission from the stellar magnetosphere.

arxiv-2408-08135.title: A comparison of combined p -value functions for meta-analysis
arxiv-2408-08135.creator: Leonhard Held, Felix Hofmann, Samuel Pawel
arxiv-2408-08135.description: Abstract Highlights What is already known • P -value functions unify hypothesis testing and parameter estimation, and are therefore particularly useful for quantitative reporting of statistical analyses. • P -value combination methods provide a general framework to perform meta-analysis. What is new • P -value functions of different p -value combination methods are compared.

arxiv-2412-17026.title: In-Memory Massive MIMO Linear Detector Circuit with Extremely High Energy Efficiency and Strong Memristive Conductance Deviation Robustness Thanks: This work was supported by the Beijing Municipal Natural Science Foundation under Grant L242013. (Corresponding author: Shaoshi Yang) Thanks: J.-H. Bi,
arxiv-2412-17026.creator: Jia-Hui Bi, Shaoshi Yang, , Ping Zhang, , Sheng Chen
arxiv-2412-17026.description: Abstract The memristive crossbar array (MCA) has been successfully applied to accelerate matrix computations of signal detection in massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems. However, the unique property of massive MIMO channel matrix makes the detection performance of existing MCA-based detectors sensitive to conductance deviations of memristive devices, and the conductance deviations are difficult to be avoided.

arxiv-2501-11906.title: Multi-source Multi-level Multi-token Ethereum Dataset and Benchmark Platform
arxiv-2501-11906.creator: Haoyuan Li, Mengxiao Zhang, Maoyuan Li, Jianzheng Li, Junyi Yang, Shuangyan Deng, Zijian Zhang, Jiamou Liu
arxiv-2501-11906.description: Abstract This paper introduces 3MEthTaskforce ( 3meth.github.io ), a multi-source, multi-level, and multi-token Ethereum dataset addressing the limitations of single-source datasets. Integrating over 300 million transaction records, 3,880 token profiles, global market indicators, and Reddit sentiment data from 2014–2024, it enables comprehensive studies on user behavior, market sentiment, and token performance.

pmc-11508810.creator: Jiajing Zhang, Pingyuan Zhang, Chunhua Zhang, Jiahao Xu, Leyan Zhang, Liangjun Xia
pmc-11508810.description: With the innovation of modern electronics, heat dissipation in the devices faces several problems. In our work, boron nitride (BN) with good thermal conductivity (TC) was successfully fabricated by constructing the BN along the axial direction and the surface-grafted BN hybrid composite fibers via the wet-spinning and hot-pressing method.

pmc-12392504.title: Inferring Nonlinear Dynamics of Cell Migration
pmc-12392504.creator: Pedrom Zadeh, Brian A. Camley
pmc-12392504.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The motility of eukaryotic cells is strongly influenced by their environment, with confined cells often developing qualitatively different motility patterns from those migrating on simple two-dimensional substrates. Recent experiments, coupled with data-driven methods to extract a cell’s equation of motion, showed that cancerous MDA-MB-231 cells persistently hop in a limit cycle when placed on two-state adhesive micropatterns (two large squares connected by a narrow bridge), while they remain stationary on average in rectangular confinements.

pmc-12584149.title: Feasibility of endovascular treatment for fetal-type posterior cerebral artery aneurysm with P1 segment aplasia: illustrative case
pmc-12584149.creator: Jun-ichi Nomura, Taichi Ishiguro, Kenichi Hodotsuka, Takakazu Kawamata
pmc-12584149.description: BACKGROUNDAneurysms of the fetal-type posterior cerebral artery (FPCA) are rare and often present with fusiform or dissecting morphology. Unlike the adult-type posterior cerebral artery (PCA), the FPCA can only be accessed through the internal carotid artery, limiting endovascular routes and device options.

pmc-12629996.title: Coexistence of entanglement-based quantum channels with DWDM classical channels over hollow core fibre in a four node quantum communication network
pmc-12629996.creator: Marcus J Clark, Obada Alia, Sima Bahrani, Gregory T Jasion, Hesham Sakr, Periklis Petropoulos, Francesco Poletti, George T Kanellos, John Rarity, Reza Nejabati, Siddarth K Joshi, Rui Wang, Dimitra Simeonidou
pmc-12629996.description: We experimentally demonstrate the coexistence of three entanglement-based quantum channels with carrier-grade classical optical channels over 11.5 km hollow core nested antiresonant nodeless fibre, in a four user quantum network. A transmission of 800 Gbps is achieved with four classical channels simultaneously with three quantum channels all operating in the C-band with a separation of 1.

pmc-12733765.title: Full-Endoscopic Lumbar Discectomy: A Review of the Surgical Techniques, Indications and Anatomical Considerations
pmc-12733765.creator: Stylianos Kapetanakis, Mikail Chatzivasiliadis, Nikolaos Gkantsinikoudis, Konstantinos Pazarlis, Panagiotis G Korovessis
pmc-12733765.description: Full-endoscopic lumbar discectomy (FELD) has emerged over time as a minimally invasive alternative to conventional microdiscectomy. This narrative review summarizes the available evidence regarding the evolution, indications, techniques, and outcomes of FELD, with a particular focus on how different types of lumbar disc herniations influence the choice of surgical approach.

pmc-12765304.title: Alternative splicing: from tumorigenesis to neoantigen-mediated cancer immunotherapy
pmc-12765304.creator: Ying-hao Lv, Yu-cheng He, Xin-ye Dai, Xiao-juan Yang, Yun-shi Cai, Rui-han Luo, Qing-yun Xie, Si-nan Xie, Xiao-ting Chen, Qing-bo Zhou, Juan Wang, Hong Wu, Tian Lan
pmc-12765304.description: Alternative splicing (AS) is a crucial post-transcriptional regulatory mechanism that is frequently disrupted in cancer, leading to the generation of tumor-specific splice variants. These aberrant splicing events, often driven by mutations in splice sites or splicing factors (SFs), produce abnormal mRNA transcripts and protein isoforms that contribute to tumor initiation, progression, and immune evasion.

pmc-12948633.title: Saudi Heart Association Position Statement on NT-proBNP for Cardiovascular Risk Screening in Asymptomatic Adults With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
pmc-12948633.creator: Waleed AlHabeeb, Adel Tash, Abdullah M. Abdullah Arabe, Lamya AlZubaidi, Ayman Al Hayek, Mohammed R. Al Safi, Malak A. Almashali
pmc-12948633.description: BackgroundType 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) is a chronic disease with a rapidly increasing prevalence, posing a significant public health challenge worldwide and in Saudi Arabia. Cardiovascular disease (CVD) is the leading cause of death among patients with T2DM, necessitating early detection and intervention to prevent disease progression.

pmc-13227902.title: Bridging the Gap: A Cross-Sectional Study of Hemodialysis Services and Patient Psychosocial Burden in Semi-urban Punjab, Pakistan
pmc-13227902.creator: Muhammad Arslan Shahid, Zeerak Laila, Muhammad Zeeshan Arif, Yousuf Shahjahan
pmc-13227902.description: BackgroundChronic kidney disease progressing to end-stage renal disease (ESRD) poses a significant public health challenge, particularly in resource-constrained settings. This clinical audit aimed to evaluate patient satisfaction, clinical practices, and the psychosocial burden among hemodialysis patients at secondary care facilities in Pakistan, benchmarking against Kidney Disease Outcomes Quality Initiative (KDOQI) and Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO) standards.

pmc-13672669.creator: Aymen Bahsoun, Jesse Hamilton, Giulia Ippolito, Christopher Brace, Chamila Perera, Wilson Sui, Jesus Fajardo, Vikas Gulani, Nicole Seiberlich, Anne Cameron, John Wei, Hero Hussain, Yun Jiang, Shane Wells
